title: 云计算和 SaaS 领域的进展与挑战
core_insight: 云计算和 SaaS 领域继续推出新功能和服务，强调了 AI 和云原生的重要性，同时也面临着安全和监管的挑战

dimension_texts.technology: AWS 推出 runtime instances，支持生产 AI 代理的持久计算，Google Cloud 的 BigQuery Graphs 和 post-quantum cryptography roadmap 体现了其在云原生和安全领域的持续投入 Amazon DynamoDB 现在支持实时向量搜索，AWS 推出 Kubernetes 版本回滚，Google Cloud 的 Database Migration Service 和 Looker 的 semantic layer 为数据管理和分析提供了更强大的支持 AWS Weekly Roundup: AWS Heroes Summit, Web Search on Amazon Bedrock, Dogwood, Kiro Crew, and more (August 10, 2026) Runtime instances: persistent compute for production AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Using BigQuery Graphs with measures for trusted agentic workloads PQC in Plaintext: Google Cloud’s post-quantum cryptography roadmap Unifying Workers AI and AI Gateway into a single AI control plane Cloudflare AI Search: give your agents a search engine for your data Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI-Augmented Code Modernization Tools 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS 推出新区域和定价优惠，Google Cloud 的区域扩张和新子海缆的引入（如 Alisios、Canoa 和 OlaLuz）增强了其全球连接性 AWS 增强算力供应和 GPU 支持，Google Cloud 的 Developer Device Platform 和 Gemini 企业数据管理能力的提升 AWS Weekly Roundup: Price reduction of GPT models in Bedrock, CloudWatch managed collectors for Prometheus metrics, and more (August 3, 2026) Expanding connectivity in the Americas: Introducing Alisios, Canoa, and OlaLuz subsea cables Ryanair adds Google to its dual-cloud flight plan
dimension_texts.application: Salesforce 推出 Headless 360，支持新行业和应用场景，Cloudflare 推出了 Radar Researcher，一个 AI 工具用于探索互联网数据 企业上云和数字化转型继续推进，Twitch 将流媒体数据提供给 Amazon 的 AI，除非用户选择退出 Scale Agent Development with Salesforce Headless 360 Introducing Radar Researcher: An AI tool for exploring Internet data in plain language Twitch feeds your streams to Amazon's AI unless you tell it to stop
dimension_texts.capital: Databricks 获得 5 亿美元投资，估值达到 1900 亿美元，Cloudflare 投资 100 万美元用于开源资金 投资者对云计算和 AI 企业的估值继续上升 IBM 与 OpenAI 合作，推动企业 AI 采用，Cloudflare 推出新社区计划和 AI 服务 Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation. Announcing Cloudflare Ambassadors, Community Engineers, and another $1M in open-source funding
dimension_texts.risk: 监管环境继续演变，数据主权和隐私成为关注点，Mystery attacker 攻击了 Salesforce 和 ServiceNow 的门户 供应链和地缘风险继续存在，AWS 密钥在 JavaScript 中暴露，可能导致 Beacon 的慈善数据泄露 X open sources its ranking algorithm, letting users see if they’ve been ‘shadowbanned’ Mystery attacker spent a year raiding Salesforce and ServiceNow portals AWS key exposed in JavaScript may have lit way to Beacon's charity data
